entry.title: New: Resolution 492 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Council: Adopts Res. 492-26 - 03/18/26
entry.content:
TRANSFERS/APPROPRIATES AN APPROPRIATION OUT AND FROM A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT AND CREDITS SAME TO A DESIGNATED FUND ACCOUNT TO PROVIDE A GRANT TO OCEAN VIEW COMMUNITY ASSOCIATION, INC., TO PURCHASE A GAZEBO AND PICNIC TABLES FOR USE AT ITS COMMUNITY GARDEN

Transfers $3,332 from the Clerk-Council Services – Contingency Relief account (Council District 6)
